idleSub: Hamba uye kuthayela ngalinye ukuze ufunde ukuthi liyini. Kuthatha cishe imizuzwana engu-20.
pausedSub: Chofoza noma ucindezele u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke.
emptySub: Engeza okuqukethwe kulo mdlalo ukuze udlalwe.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukopishe nge-Ctrl noma i-Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wemephu yemiqondo. Hambisa isiqephu ukuya kumqondo ngamunye.
stageHow: Hamba ngemicibisholo noma ngo-W A S D. Cindezela u-N ukuze uye emqondweni olandelayo. Cindezela u-Escape ukuze umise. Cindezela u-Tab ukuze uqhubekele phambili. Umbhalo ogcwele futhi ungaphansi kokuthi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: Imicibisholo noma i-WASD ukuhamba. U-N womqondo olandelayo.
guideText: Hamba uye kuthayela likhazimulayo ukuze ufunde ukuthi liyini. Lonke ithayela olithintayo lijoyina imephu.
